title: Extension by zero adjunction preserving monomorphisms
statement: For a category C, a Grothendieck topology J on C, and W : C, assuming HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat and HasSheafify (J.over W) AddCommGrpCat, there exists a functor L : Sheaf (J.over W) AddCommGrpCat ⥤ Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat with Nonempty (L ⊣ J.overPullback AddCommGrpCat W) and L.PreservesMonomorphisms.

proof.text: Use siteExtensionByZeroPresheaf W: its sections are direct sums over arrows V -> W, and its morphisms act componentwise. Construct the presheaf hom equivalence by extending a slice morphism to the sum and conversely restricting a presheaf morphism to each direct-sum injection. Check naturality on each injection, identifying slice morphisms by their underlying arrows. DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of and direct-sum extensionality prove the inverse laws and naturality in both variables, giving the presheaf adjunction (private sumAdjunction).

Let L be sheafToPresheaf (J.over W) followed by siteExtensionByZeroPresheaf W and presheafToSheaf J. Compose the presheaf adjunction with sheafificationAdjunction J and restrict along the fully faithful inclusion of slice sheaves, using Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful. Continuity of Over.forget W identifies the right adjoint with J.overPullback. This constructs the witness and adjunction for the arbitrary Grothendieck topology J.

For a mono of abelian presheaves, NatTrans.mono_iff_mono_app and AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective imply injectivity of each component. The direct-sum map is DirectSum.map of these components, hence injective by DirectSum.map_injective, so presheaf extension by zero preserves monos. The inclusion of sheaves preserves monos and HasSheafify supplies finite-limit preservation, hence mono preservation, for presheafToSheaf J. Composition therefore proves L.PreservesMonomorphisms. Package L, the constructed adjunction, and this preservation proof.
